topics: Introduction to Book keeping and Accounting –– Accounting Process
Purpose of accounting – Classification of accounting – Generally Accepted Accounting Principles – Conventions and Concepts – Double entry system of accounting
Preparation of Journal, Ledger and Trial Balance. (Illustrative problem)
Introduction to financial statements – Preparation of Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet. (Simple problems)
Rate of Return method – Minimum attractive rate of return (MARR)
Internal Rate of Return (IRR) – Economic Decision Making using Incremental Rate of Return (IRoR) Analysis of public projects – Benefit cost analysis – applications.
Breakeven analysis – Fixed and variable cost – Total cost – Breakeven point and breakeven chart– Interpretation, limitations.
Working capital – Operating cycle – Working capital management – Sources of finance - long term and short term financing.
Financing of PPP projects – Sources of project finance – Providers of finance – Financial structure – Financial indicators – Special nature of infrastructure financing need.
Time value of money – Simple and Compound interest – Time value equivalence –Cash flow diagrams – Interest calculations – Compound interest factors – Interest tables.
Evaluating alternatives by equivalence – Present worth comparison – Future worth comparison – Annual cost and worth comparison.

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Describe the principles and process of accounting.
Apply basic analysis tools like rate of return, benefit cost, and breakeven analysis in economic decision making.
Prepare financial statements and apply revenue recognition methods.
Explain the basics of financial management and sources of finance for  a project.

referenceBooks.title: Finance for Engineers- Evaluation and Funding of Capital Projects
referenceBooks.author: Crundwell F.K.
